findings.title: FallbackLocaleList inherits from Hash but never reads or writes its storage
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList < Hash` overrides `#[]` to return a hardcoded array `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` and never consults or updates the underlying Hash. This silently breaks the standard i18n `I18n.fallbacks` API: any code (including future plugin code, the Rails-generated `config.i18n.fallbacks`, or `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks#map=`) that sets a key via `fallbacks[locale] = ...` or calls methods like `each`/`map`/`merge` on `I18n.fallbacks` will get Hash-level behavior rather than the intended Fallbacks behavior, and the custom mapping will be completely ignored by `#[]`. Either don't subclass Hash, or implement the API of `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks` (including honoring a `map`) so that the object behaves like the fallback chain it replaces.

findings.title: Critical load-order comment is not actually enforced
findings.body: The file starts with the comment `# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb`, but the filename is `config/initializers/i18n.rb` with no numeric prefix. Rails initializers are loaded by sorted filename, so whether this runs after `02-freedom_patches.rb` depends entirely on the other initializers in the directory. This initializer calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` at runtime, which is defined by `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb`. If the accelerator patch has not been loaded yet, every request that hits `set_locale` will raise `NoMethodError: undefined method 'ensure_loaded!' for I18n:Module`. The ordering requirement should be made real (e.g. rename to `config/initializers/03-i18n.rb` and remove `config/initializers/02-freedom_patches.rb`'s require, or just `require_dependency` the accelerator from this file) rather than left as a comment.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! takes LOAD_MUTEX once per fallback locale on every request
findings.body: `set_locale` runs as a `before_filter` on every request, and now calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`, which iterates the fallback chain and calls `I18n.ensure_loaded! l` for each entry. Each call enters `LOAD_MUTEX.synchronize` in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` to re-check `@loaded_locales`. After the first request all locales are loaded, so the body of the synchronized block is a no-op, but the mutex is still acquired and released N times per request (3 by default). Under load this is pure contention overhead. A single `synchronize` that checks all needed locales once would be both faster and race-free.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! checks @loaded_locales outside the mutex
findings.body: The new `ensure_loaded!` does `@loaded_locales ||= []; load_locale locale unless @loaded_locales.include?(locale)`. The membership check happens without `LOAD_MUTEX`, so under contention many threads can race past it and pile up on `load_locale`'s mutex. `load_locale` does re-check inside the mutex and returns early, so this isn't a correctness bug, but it defeats the purpose of the outer check (which exists precisely to avoid the lock) and means the outer check is effectively dead code that only adds a racy read of `@loaded_locales`. Move the existence check inside the synchronized block, or use a concurrent set.

findings.title: New fallback feature ships with no tests
findings.body: This is a server-wide behavior change: every translation lookup now silently falls back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` and then to English, and `set_locale` triggers lazy loading of every fallback locale on every request. Despite being titled FEATURE and described as 'Test 9', the PR adds no specs for `FallbackLocaleList#[ ]` ordering, `ensure_loaded!` loading behavior, the interaction with `translate_accelerator`, the Fallbacks backend integration, or the removal of the explicit `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from the environment files. There is no way to tell from this change whether the new fallback chain is correct (e.g. that `:en` is still reached when the site default is not English) or that the new initializer order won't break boot.
